name: Desktop state
description: The user's desktop session, desktop settings, appearance and installed-App index and per-App state, kept by the Fleet controller (docs/os/desktop-state.md).
notes: Controller-hosted; no package. Every call is scoped to the caller's Fleet and user by the controller.

tools.name: get
tools.description: The caller's desktop: session (nominal size, spaces, stacking, windows), settings, appearance, the installed-App index and the change subject.

tools.name: intent
tools.description: Apply one desktop intent (open, close, move, resize, raise, set, spaces, nominal, bind_browser) and return {seq, ops, ...result}.

tools.name: settings_put
tools.description: Replace the desktop settings (settings) or merge top-level keys into them (patch, null removes); with revision, a stale write returns {conflict, revision, settings}.

tools.name: appearance_put
tools.description: Set the appearance preference: light, dark or system.

tools.name: import
tools.description: Adopt Workspace files (session record, settings, appearance), each only while the caller's keys for it are absent; boot drops container-bound windows of another Workspace lifetime.

tools.name: apps_put
tools.description: Replace the installed-App index (a list of entries, one per App id; icon_hash names an icon stored with apps_icon_put). An unchanged index is not written; with revision, a stale write returns {conflict, revision}. Returns {revision, missing_icons}.

tools.name: apps_icon_put
tools.description: Store the icon (a data:image/ URI) the App index names for app_id by its icon_hash.

tools.name: apps_icon
tools.description: One App's stored icon: {icon, hash}, or {icon: null}.

tools.name: app_state_get
tools.description: One App's durable state (shared by its desktop windows and App pages): {app_id, revision, state}; revision 0 and state null while it has none.

tools.name: app_state_put
tools.description: Replace an App's state (state) or merge top-level keys into it (patch, null removes); with revision (0: none yet), a stale write returns {conflict, revision, state}. Limited to 256 KB. Announced as desktop.app_state {app_id, revision}.
